Cash is $445.88, which is below the $500 buy threshold, so no new buys are possible and none would be wise anyway. daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-off means investors are getting nervous and moving money out of riskier assets like growth and tech stocks, often into safer places like cash or bonds. You can spot it when major indexes fall together, especially when the tech-heavy NASDAQ falls more than the overall market. On risk-off days it is often smarter to hold what you own and not buy anything new until the mood improves.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險情緒」（Risk-Off）是指投資者轉趨審慎，把資金從成長股、科技股等高風險資產撤出，轉投現金或債券等較穩健的資產。主要指數同步下跌，而以科技股為主的納指跌幅又大於大市時，通常就是避險情緒升溫的訊號。在這種市況下，較穩妥的做法是持有現有倉位、暫停新買入，等市場氣氛回暖再部署。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks fell across the board today, with the tech-heavy NASDAQ (-1.4%) down more than the broader S&P 500 (-0.9%). When the NASDAQ falls harder than the S&P 500, investors are usually pulling back from riskier, high-valuation growth stocks. No news headlines came with today's data, so this summary describes the price action only and does not claim a specific cause.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全線下挫，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數跌1.4%，跌幅大於標普500指數的0.9%。納指跌幅大於標普500，通常代表資金正從高估值、高風險的成長股撤出，市場情緒轉趨保守。今日數據未附帶新聞標題，因此本摘要只描述價格走勢，不推斷具體原因。
